 Community Scholars – Application Tips 
 Community Scholars
 Meet the Scholars
 Application Tips
 Application Tips
 Through the Chick-fil-A ™ Community Scholars program, Chick-fil-A, Inc. helps pay for the education of leaders in our communities who want to continue learning, while also investing in their leadership development.
 Apply now 
 Key Dates
 Applications open
 August 21, 2026
 Applications close
 November 3, 2026
 Scholarship recipients notified
 Spring 2027
 Award payments distributed 
 July 2027
 Keep in mind
 Apply early
 Beginning early will allow more time to ask questions, gather transcripts and thoughtfully complete your application. It will also give your recommender more time to fill out the recommendation portion. No applications will be accepted after the deadline.
 Request a transcript
 As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to upload a transcript that includes your name, your current or most recent school’s name, your grade point average (GPA) and the number of credit hours for each class taken.
 Answer thoroughly
 When answering questions, include specific details about academic honors, community care and service opportunities, etc., to make your application as informative and competitive as possible. We also recommend sharing your application with an adult or peer/mentor before submission to ensure your responses are complete.
 Eligibility
 To apply to become a 2027 Chick-fil-A Community Scholar, you must:
 Be a resident in the United States, Puerto Rico or Canada. 
 Be a postsecondary undergraduate or graduate student or planning to enroll in undergraduate or graduate study at an accredited two- or four-year college, university or vocational-technical school for the 2027-2028 academic year. 
 Have a minimum cumulative grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale (or the equivalent). Academic awards and recognition will be considered. Applicants are required to upload a transcript that displays their name, school name, classes taken and GPA. 
 Demonstrate financial need. 
 Not be employed at a Chick-fil-A ® restaurant or Chick-fil-A, Inc. at the time of application or the dependent or spouse of a Chick-fil-A, Inc. Employee or Operator.
